hints.title: Three regions
hints.body: Intervals entirely before the new one, intervals that merge with it, and intervals entirely after it.

hints.title: Before and after
hints.body: Copy intervals whose end is smaller than the incoming start. Then absorb every interval whose start is at most the incoming end.

hints.title: Expand while absorbing
hints.body: The merged interval may grow to the right as more intervals are absorbed.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
result = []
i = 0
while i < len(intervals) and intervals[i][1] < incoming[0]:
    result.append(intervals[i]); i += 1
start, end = incoming
while i < len(intervals) and intervals[i][0] <= end:
    start = min(start, intervals[i][0])
    end = max(end, intervals[i][1])
    i += 1
result.append([start, end])
result.extend(intervals[i:])
return result
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
